text: The communicable diseases to know, as pathogen, route and prevention. Tuberculosis, by droplets, prevented by B C G and DOTS treatment. Typhoid and cholera, from contaminated water. Hepatitis B, by blood. Rabies, by an animal bite. Dengue, carried by the Aedes mosquito, now spreading in Nepal's cities. Kala azar by the sandfly. And roundworm, from soil on unwashed food.
